Subject: California Public Records Request :: W013534-092926
Body:
RE: PUBLIC RECORDS REQUEST of September 29, 2026, Reference # W013534-092926
 
Dear Brian C,
 
The City received the following records request from you on September 29, 2026.
 
Under the California Public Records Act, I request records concerning a single Flock Safety ALPR search conducted under the San Mateo Police Department's Flock account: search ID e3ff26d0-8f26-43d6-8e73-7c70b723b665, conducted 04/09/2024 at 07:44:34 PM UTC, 428 networks searched.

As you are aware, each search under the Department's Flock account is recorded with a search ID, a time, a network count, and a reason entered by the user.

Please provide the following:

1. The Flock Audit PDF report record for this search, including every field of that record, among them the reason text as entered by the user.

2. The organization-audit spreadsheet/CSV export record for this search, in its native electronic format (.csv or .xlsx) (Gov. Code § 7922.570), including every field of that record, among them the reason text as entered by the user, the Case # field, the Time Frame, and the Filters.

3. Any CAD incident, RMS entry, incident report, or case report that the Department associates with this search, or that bears a case, incident, or file number entered for this search.

4. Any record reflecting a request for this search from any person or agency, or an approval of it, including any email, text message, chat or messaging-app message, dispatch or assist record, supervisor approval, or task-force record held by the City.

5. Any record reflecting the provision of this search's results (including plate reads, images, locations, or reports) to any person or entity outside the Department, including any email, text message, or chat or messaging-app message, and any Flock share, export, or download of the results (including the corresponding Flock event-log entries). This includes messages sent or received by the user recorded for this search in the Flock audit record, on City accounts or devices and on any personal account or device used to conduct City business (City of San Jose v. Superior Court (2017) 2 Cal.5th 608).

For items 4 and 5, I'd ask that the search of email and messaging accounts use as search terms the search ID above and each case, incident, or file number entered for this search in its Flock audit record (in the reason text or the Case # field), for the period April 1, 2024 through the date of this request.

If any portion of these records is withheld, I'd ask that it be marked in place, field by field, with the exemption relied on for that portion, so the remainder can be released (Gov. Code § § 7922.525(b), 7922.540). If the Department's position is that a responsive record is held by another agency rather than the City, please say so for that record.

This request concerns one search and seeks records beyond the audit log itself (items 3 through 5). It is separate from any other pending request, including any rolling production of monthly audit logs, and I'd ask that it be handled on its own.

Thank you,

Brian
 
We have made a good faith and diligent effort to complete your request, in which responsive records have been collected. These records as well as the Department's response letter are available on the San Mateo Records Request Portal. Select the link below to view. 
 
The City has completed its response to your request and now considers this record request
W013534-092926  closed.
 
If you have any questions, please contact me using the below contact information.
 

Sincerely,  

 

Kelly O'Keefe
